chunks: And from him, from Fadalah, from Ibn Sinan, who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) praying, raising his hands near his face when he began (the prayer).
ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Sadiq raise his hands when beginning the prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* provides a direct visual account of Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) raising his hands to the level of his face during the opening takbir, a practice that underscores the Sunnah of *raf' al-yadayn* in Shia jurisprudence. It highlights the precision of the Imam’s physical worship, serving as a key evidence for the recommended etiquette of the opening prayer, distinct from mere necessity. The report emphasizes the continuity of prophetic tradition through the Imams, reinforcing the legitimacy of this specific gesture in Shia ritual practice.
